name: Aura: Righteous Call
descr:
Granted by [Righteous Call](/action/righteous-call-gm-core)

Strikes your allies make while they're within 30 feet of you gain the [holy](/trait/holy) trait.

name: Aura: Searing Blade (Greater)
descr:
Granted by [Searing Blade (Greater)](/item/searing-blade-greater-gm-core)

A 10-foot emanation of flame radiates from the *greater searing blade* for 1 minute. All weapon and unarmed attacks by you and your allies within the area gain the effect of the *flaming* property rune.

name: Aura: Shining Symbol
descr:
Granted by [Shining Symbol](/item/shining-symbol-gm-core), [Shining Symbol (Greater)](/item/shining-symbol-greater-gm-core), [Shining Symbol (Major)](/item/shining-symbol-major-gm-core)

The light cast by the symbol becomes bright light. Creatures in the light receive a status penalty to Deception and Stealth checks and your enemies gain weakness to spirit damage.

name: Effect: Aeon Stone (Sprouting)
descr:
Granted by [Aeon Stone (Sprouting)](/item/aeon-stone-sprouting-gm-core)

You gain 8 temporary Hit Points.

name: Effect: Aeon Stone Resonance (Amplifying)
descr:
Granted by [Aeon Stone (Amplifying)](/item/aeon-stone-amplifying-gm-core)

The resonant power grants you a +2 item bonus to Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion checks-whichever corresponds to the tradition of the last spell you enhanced with this *aeon stone*.

name: Effect: Alloy Orb (Exquisite High-Grade)
descr:
Granted by [Alloy Orb (Exquisite High Grade)](/item/alloy-orb-exquisite-high-grade-gm-core)

When you activate the *alloy orb*, select adamantine, cold iron, or dawnsilver. The affixed weapon functions as the chosen material.

name: Effect: Alloy Orb (Exquisite Standard-Grade)
descr:
Granted by [Alloy Orb (Exquisite Standard Grade)](/item/alloy-orb-exquisite-standard-grade-gm-core)

When you activate the *alloy orb*, select adamantine, cold iron, or dawnsilver. The affixed weapon functions as the chosen material.

name: Effect: Alloy Orb (High-Grade)
descr:
Granted by [Alloy Orb (High Grade)](/item/alloy-orb-high-grade-gm-core)

When you activate the *alloy orb*, select cold iron or silver. The affixed weapon functions as the chosen material.

name: Effect: Alloy Orb (Low-Grade)
descr:
Granted by [Alloy Orb (Low Grade)](/item/alloy-orb-low-grade-gm-core)

When you activate the *alloy orb*, select cold iron or silver. The affixed weapon functions as the chosen material.

name: Effect: Alloy Orb (Standard-Grade)
descr:
Granted by [Alloy Orb (Standard Grade)](/item/alloy-orb-standard-grade-gm-core)

When you activate the *alloy orb*, select cold iron or silver. The affixed weapon functions as the chosen material.

name: Effect: Antidote
descr:
Granted by [Antidote (Lesser)](/item/antidote-lesser-gm-core), [Antidote (Greater)](/item/antidote-greater-gm-core), [Antidote (Moderate)](/item/antidote-moderate-gm-core), [Antidote (Major)](/item/antidote-major-gm-core)

You gain an item bonus to Fortitude saves against poisons.

name: Effect: Antiplague
descr:
Granted by [Antiplague (Lesser)](/item/antiplague-lesser-gm-core), [Antiplague (Moderate)](/item/antiplague-moderate-gm-core), [Antiplague (Greater)](/item/antiplague-greater-gm-core), [Antiplague (Major)](/item/antiplague-major-gm-core)

You gain an item bonus to Fortitude saves against diseases.

name: Effect: Barding of the Zephyr
descr:
Granted by [Barding Of The Zephyr](/item/barding-of-the-zephyr-gm-core)

You trace a finger along the wind motifs on the barding, granting your companion wearing the barding a fly Speed of 30 feet for 10 minutes. Even if the companion doesn't have the mount special ability, it can still Fly while being ridden.

name: Effect: Bloodseeker Beak
descr:
Granted by [Bloodseeker Beak](/item/bloodseeker-beak-gm-core), [Bloodseeker Beak (Greater)](/item/bloodseeker-beak-greater-gm-core)

You deal an extra d4 precision damage on your damage roll.

name: Effect: Bomber's Eye Elixir
descr:
Granted by [Bomber'S Eye Elixir (Lesser)](/item/bomber-s-eye-elixir-lesser-gm-core), [Bomber'S Eye Elixir (Greater)](/item/bomber-s-eye-elixir-greater-gm-core)

Your alchemical bomb Strikes reduce the circumstance bonus to AC your targets gain from cover.

name: Effect: Bomber's Eye Elixir Cover Reduction
descr:
Granted by Effect: Bomber'S Eye Elixir

Your bonus to AC from cover is reduced.

name: Effect: Bravo's Brew
descr:
Granted by [Bravo'S Brew (Lesser)](/item/bravo-s-brew-lesser-gm-core), [Bravo'S Brew (Moderate)](/item/bravo-s-brew-moderate-gm-core), [Bravo'S Brew (Greater)](/item/bravo-s-brew-greater-gm-core)

You gain an item bonus to Will saves. This bonus increases when attempting Will saves against fear. If you consumed a *greater bravo's brew*, when you roll a success on a save against fear, you get a critical success instead.

name: Effect: Bronze Bull Pendant
descr:
Granted by [Bronze Bull Pendant](/item/bronze-bull-pendant-gm-core)

You gain a +1 item bonus to attempt an Athletics check to Shove.

name: Effect: Call Upon the Ancient Life
descr:
Granted by [Belt Of Long Life](/item/belt-of-long-life-gm-core)

You recover 15 Hit Points at the start of your turn.

*Note: Adjust duration based on roll results.*

name: Effect: Cheetah's Elixir (Greater)
descr:
Granted by [Cheetah'S Elixir (Greater)](/item/cheetah-s-elixir-greater-gm-core)

You gain a +10 foot status bonus to your Speed.

name: Effect: Cheetah's Elixir (Lesser)
descr:
Granted by [Cheetah'S Elixir (Lesser)](/item/cheetah-s-elixir-lesser-gm-core)

You gain a +5 foot status bonus to your Speed.

name: Effect: Cheetah's Elixir (Moderate)
descr:
Granted by [Cheetah'S Elixir (Moderate)](/item/cheetah-s-elixir-moderate-gm-core)

You gain a +10 foot status bonus to your Speed.

name: Effect: Clawed Bracers
descr:
Granted by [Clawed Bracers](/item/clawed-bracers-gm-core)

You gain a climb Speed of 20 feet and a claw unarmed attack with the agile and [finesse](/trait/finesse) traits that deals 1d6 slashing damage.

name: Effect: Cloak of Swiftness
descr:
Granted by [Cloak Of Swiftness](/item/cloak-of-swiftness-gm-core)

You gain a fly Speed of 30 feet and become concealed.

name: Effect: Darkvision Elixir (Greater)
descr:
Granted by [Darkvision Elixir (Greater)](/item/darkvision-elixir-greater-gm-core)

You gain Darkvision

name: Effect: Darkvision Elixir (Lesser)
descr:
Granted by [Darkvision Elixir (Lesser)](/item/darkvision-elixir-lesser-gm-core)

You gain Darkvision.

name: Effect: Darkvision Elixir (Moderate)
descr:
Granted by [Darkvision Elixir (Moderate)](/item/darkvision-elixir-moderate-gm-core)

You gain Darkvision

name: Effect: Diplomat's Badge
descr:
Granted by [Diplomat'S Badge](/item/diplomat-s-badge-gm-core)

The badge's bonus increases to +2 for Diplomacy checks with creatures of that group for the rest of the day.

name: Effect: Dragon Turtle Scale
descr:
Granted by [Dragon Turtle Scale](/item/dragon-turtle-scale-gm-core), [Dragon Turtle Scale (Greater)](/item/dragon-turtle-scale-greater-gm-core)

You gain a swim Speed equal to half your land Speed or equal to your land Speed (*greater*) .

name: Effect: Eagle Eye Elixir
descr:
Granted by [Eagle Eye Elixir (Lesser)](/item/eagle-eye-elixir-lesser-gm-core), [Eagle Eye Elixir (Moderate)](/item/eagle-eye-elixir-moderate-gm-core), [Eagle Eye Elixir (Greater)](/item/eagle-eye-elixir-greater-gm-core), [Eagle Eye Elixir (Major)](/item/eagle-eye-elixir-major-gm-core)

You gain an item bonus to Perception checks that is greater when attempting to find secret doors and traps.

name: Effect: Elixir of Life
descr:
Granted by [Elixir Of Life (Minor)](/item/elixir-of-life-minor-gm-core), [Elixir Of Life (Lesser)](/item/elixir-of-life-lesser-gm-core), [Elixir Of Life (Moderate)](/item/elixir-of-life-moderate-gm-core), [Elixir Of Life (Greater)](/item/elixir-of-life-greater-gm-core), [Elixir Of Life (Major)](/item/elixir-of-life-major-gm-core), [Elixir Of Life (True)](/item/elixir-of-life-true-gm-core)

You gain an item bonus to saving throws against diseases and poisons.

name: Effect: Force Shield
descr:
Granted by [Force Shield](/item/force-shield-gm-core)

The shield surrounds you with a bubble of force that protects you from harm, granting you resistance 5 to physical damage.

name: Effect: Forge Warden
descr:
Granted by [Forge Warden](/item/forge-warden-gm-core)

You and any adjacent allies have fire resistance 5 while you have the shield raised.

name: Effect: Forgefather's Seal
descr:
Granted by [Forgefather'S Seal](/item/forgefather-s-seal-gm-core)

You gain fire resistance 40. You ignore the armor's check penalty and Speed penalty (if any); if the armor is light or medium, increase its item bonus to AC by 1.

name: Effect: Forgefather's Seal (Stalwart Sacrifice)
descr:
Granted by [Forgefather'S Seal](/item/forgefather-s-seal-gm-core)

The chosen creatures also gain a +4 status bonus to AC and saving throws, and fast healing 15.

name: Effect: Glow Rod
descr:
Granted by [Glow Rod](/item/glow-rod-gm-core)

The rod sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius (and dim light to the next 40 feet).

name: Effect: Glue Bomb
descr:
Granted by [Glue Bomb (Lesser)](/item/glue-bomb-lesser-gm-core), [Glue Bomb (Moderate)](/item/glue-bomb-moderate-gm-core), [Glue Bomb (Greater)](/item/glue-bomb-greater-gm-core), [Glue Bomb (Major)](/item/glue-bomb-major-gm-core)

The target takes a status penalty to its speeds.

name: Effect: Horn of Exorcism (Sacred Seeds)
descr:
Granted by [Horn Of Exorcism](/item/horn-of-exorcism-gm-core)

The horn grants you the *ghost touch* property rune on all of your weapon and unarmed Strikes.

name: Effect: Impenetrable Scale
descr:
Granted by [Impenetrable Scale](/item/impenetrable-scale-gm-core)

You gain resistance to physical damage equal to the number of violet scales, to a maximum of 8.

name: Effect: Iron Medallion
descr:
Granted by [Iron Medallion](/item/iron-medallion-gm-core)

You gain a +2 status bonus to the triggering save and other saves against fear.

name: Effect: Lion's Bite
descr:
Granted by [Lion'S Shield](/item/lion-s-shield-gm-core)

The shield's biting maw is a martial melee weapon that deals 2d6 piercing damage and has the [deadly d6](/trait/deadly) trait; it can't be enhanced by runes.

name: Effect: Mummified Bat
descr:
Granted by [Mummified Bat](/item/mummified-bat-gm-core)

If you have the [Blind-Fight](/feat/blind-fight-player-core) feat, you gain imprecise echolocation with a range of 30 feet.

name: Effect: Obsidian Goggles
descr:
Granted by [Obsidian Goggles](/item/obsidian-goggles-gm-core)

You gain darkvision for 1 hour.

name: Effect: Obsidian Goggles (Greater)
descr:
Granted by [Obsidian Goggles (Greater)](/item/obsidian-goggles-greater-gm-core)

You gain darkvision until you deactivate it as an [Interact](/action/interact-player-core) action or the item is no longer invested by you, whichever comes first.

name: Effect: Obsidian Goggles (Major)
descr:
Granted by [Obsidian Goggles (Major)](/item/obsidian-goggles-major-gm-core)

You gain *greater darkvision* until you deactivate it as an [Interact](/action/interact-player-core) action or the item is no longer invested by you, whichever comes first.

name: Effect: Oil of Keen Edges
descr:
Granted by [Oil Of Keen Edges](/item/oil-of-keen-edges-gm-core)

The weapon grows sharper and more dangerous, granting it the benefits of the *[keen](/item/keen-gm-core)* rune.

name: Effect: Oil of Potency
descr:
Granted by [Oil Of Potency](/item/oil-of-potency-gm-core), [Oil Of Potency (Greater)](/item/oil-of-potency-greater-gm-core), [Oil Of Potency (Major)](/item/oil-of-potency-major-gm-core)

A weapon temporarily becomes a *+1 [striking](/item/striking-gm-core) weapon*, a *+2 greater striking weapon*, or a *+3 major striking weapon*.Armor temporarily becomes *+1 [resilient](/item/resilient-gm-core) armor*, *+2 greater resilient armor*, or *+3 major resilient armor*.

name: Effect: Potency Crystal
descr:
Granted by [Potency Crystal](/item/potency-crystal-gm-core), [Potency Crystal (Greater)](/item/potency-crystal-greater-gm-core), [Potency Crystal (Major)](/item/potency-crystal-major-gm-core)

The weapon becomes a *+1 [striking](/item/striking-gm-core) weapon*, a *+2 greater striking weapon*, or a *+3 major striking weapon*.

name: Effect: Potion of Acid Resistance
descr:
Granted by [Potion Of Acid Resistance (Lesser)](/item/potion-of-acid-resistance-lesser-gm-core), [Potion Of Acid Resistance (Moderate)](/item/potion-of-acid-resistance-moderate-gm-core), [Potion Of Acid Resistance (Greater)](/item/potion-of-acid-resistance-greater-gm-core)

You gain resistance against acid damage.

name: Effect: Potion of Electricity Resistance
descr:
Granted by [Potion Of Electricity Resistance (Lesser)](/item/potion-of-electricity-resistance-lesser-gm-core), [Potion Of Electricity Resistance (Moderate)](/item/potion-of-electricity-resistance-moderate-gm-core), Potion Of Electricity Resistance (Lesser)

You gain resistance against electricity damage.

name: Effect: Potion of Emergency Escape
descr:
Granted by [Potion Of Emergency Escape](/item/potion-of-emergency-escape-gm-core)

You become fleeing and you gain a +40-foot status bonus to all your Speeds for the duration as long as you are fleeing.

name: Effect: Potion of Fire Resistance
descr:
Granted by [Potion Of Fire Resistance (Lesser)](/item/potion-of-fire-resistance-lesser-gm-core), Potion Of Fire Resistance (Moderate), [Potion Of Fire Resistance (Greater)](/item/potion-of-fire-resistance-greater-gm-core)

You gain resistance to fire damage.

name: Effect: Potion of Flying (Greater)
descr:
Granted by [Potion Of Flying (Greater)](/item/potion-of-flying-greater-gm-core)

You gain a fly Speed of 40 feet.

name: Effect: Potion of Flying (Standard)
descr:
Granted by [Potion Of Flying (Standard)](/item/potion-of-flying-standard-gm-core)

You gain a fly Speed of 40 feet.

name: Effect: Potion of Sonic Resistance
descr:
Granted by [Potion Of Sonic Resistance (Lesser)](/item/potion-of-sonic-resistance-lesser-gm-core), [Potion Of Sonic Resistance (Moderate)](/item/potion-of-sonic-resistance-moderate-gm-core), [Potion Of Sonic Resistance (Greater)](/item/potion-of-sonic-resistance-greater-gm-core)

You gain resistance against sonic damage.

name: Effect: Potion of Swimming
descr:
Granted by [Potion Of Swimming](/item/potion-of-swimming-gm-core)

You gain a swim Speed equal to your land Speed.

name: Effect: Potion of Swimming (Greater)
descr:
Granted by [Potion Of Swimming (Greater)](/item/potion-of-swimming-greater-gm-core)

You gain a swim Speed equal to your land Speed.

name: Effect: Powder Burst
descr: -2 status penalty to Perception checks and saves against mental effects.

name: Effect: Predator's Claw
descr:
Granted by [Predator'S Claw](/item/predator-s-claw-gm-core)

The triggering attack gains the weapon's critical specialization effect.

name: Effect: Righteous Call
descr:
Granted by [Righteous Call](/action/righteous-call-gm-core)

Your Strikes gain the [holy](/trait/holy) trait.

name: Effect: Sea Touch Elixir (Greater)
descr:
Granted by [Sea Touch Elixir (Greater)](/item/sea-touch-elixir-greater-gm-core)

You gain a swim Speed of 20 feet.

name: Effect: Sea Touch Elixir (Lesser)
descr:
Granted by [Sea Touch Elixir (Lesser)](/item/sea-touch-elixir-lesser-gm-core)

You gain a swim Speed of 20 feet.

name: Effect: Sea Touch Elixir (Moderate)
descr:
Granted by [Sea Touch Elixir (Moderate)](/item/sea-touch-elixir-moderate-gm-core)

You gain a swim Speed of 20 feet.

name: Effect: Searing Blade (Greater)
descr:
Granted by [Searing Blade (Greater)](/item/searing-blade-greater-gm-core)

All weapon and unarmed attacks by you and your allies within the area gain the effect of the *flaming* property rune.

name: Effect: Shark Tooth Charm
descr:
Granted by [Shark Tooth Charm](/item/shark-tooth-charm-gm-core)

You receive a +1 item bonus to your attempt to Escape using Acrobatics. If you roll a success, you get a critical success instead (if you roll a critical failure, you get a failure instead).

name: Effect: Shining Ammunition
descr:
Granted by [Shining Ammunition](/item/shining-ammunition-gm-core)

You shed bright light in a 20-foot radius (and dim light to the next 20 feet).

name: Effect: Shining Symbol
descr:
Granted by [Shining Symbol](/item/shining-symbol-gm-core), [Shining Symbol (Greater)](/item/shining-symbol-greater-gm-core), [Shining Symbol (Major)](/item/shining-symbol-major-gm-core)

Creatures in the light receive a status penalty to Deception and Stealth checks.

name: Effect: Shining Symbol Weakness
descr:
Granted by [Shining Symbol](/item/shining-symbol-gm-core), [Shining Symbol (Greater)](/item/shining-symbol-greater-gm-core), [Shining Symbol (Major)](/item/shining-symbol-major-gm-core)

Your enemies gain weakness to spirit damage.

name: Effect: Shrinking Potion
descr:
Granted by [Shrinking Potion](/item/shrinking-potion-gm-core)

You gain the effects of the *[shrink](/spell/shrink-player-core)* spell.

name: Effect: Shrinking Potion (Greater)
descr:
Granted by [Shrinking Potion (Greater)](/item/shrinking-potion-greater-gm-core)

You gain the effects of a 4th-rank *[shrink](/spell/shrink-player-core)* spell and a +2 item bonus to Stealth checks while shrunken.

name: Effect: Silver Salve
descr:
Granted by [Silver Salve](/item/silver-salve-gm-core)

The weapon or ammunition counts as silver instead of its normal material (such as cold iron) for any physical damage it deals.

name: Effect: Sneaky Key
descr:
Granted by [Sneaky Key](/item/sneaky-key-gm-core)

You gain a +1 status bonus to Thievery checks to Pick a Lock.

name: Effect: Staff of Illumination
descr:
Granted by [Staff Of Illumination](/item/staff-of-illumination-gm-core)

You shed bright light in a 20-foot radius (and dim light to the next 20 feet).

name: Effect: Swift Block Cabochon
descr:
Granted by [Swift Block Cabochon](/item/swift-block-cabochon-gm-core)

Increase the shield's Hardness by 5 against the triggering attack.

name: Effect: Thurible of Revelation
descr:
Granted by [Thurible Of Revelation (Lesser)](/item/thurible-of-revelation-lesser-gm-core), [Thurible Of Revelation (Moderate)](/item/thurible-of-revelation-moderate-gm-core), [Thurible Of Revelation (Greater)](/item/thurible-of-revelation-greater-gm-core)

You gain an item bonus to Religion checks and any critical failure you roll when you Decipher Writing of a religious nature is a failure instead.

name: Effect: Tiger Menuki
descr:
Granted by [Tiger Menuki](/item/tiger-menuki-gm-core)

The weapon gains the forceful and [sweep](/trait/sweep) traits on the triggering Strike and all other Strikes.

name: Effect: Wind Barrier
descr:
Granted by [Wind Barrier](/action/wind-barrier-gm-core)

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against ranged attacks. At 13th level, this increases to a +3 circumstance bonus to AC against ranged attacks.

name: Effect: Winged Sandals
descr:
Granted by [Winged Sandals](/item/winged-sandals-gm-core)

You gain a fly Speed of 30 feet.

name: Spell Effect: Hidden Mind
descr:
Granted by [Hidden Mind](/spell/hidden-mind-gm-core)

You gain a +4 status bonus to saves against mental effects.
